units: Gen. R. s. 34 (play on קַיִץ, Gen. VIII, 22) מְקַיֵּיץ אני עליהם את העוף I shall make the birds feed on them in the summer (with ref. to וקץ, Is. l. c.).—2) (v. קַיִץ) to supply the altar during the dull season. Y. Yoma V, beg. 42ᵇ מְקַיְּיצִים בה וכ׳ they supply the altar with it, i.e. use it for sacrifices when the altar is otherwise unemployed; Y. Shek. I, 48ᵃ bot.; Shebu. 12ᵃ מְקַיְּצִין בהן וכ׳.
<cite ref="Shevuot 12a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>אין מקיצין בגופן וכ׳</he> we do not use them bodily as sacrifices, but what we buy with their value.
<cite ref="Shevuot 12b:2">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>אין מקיצין בעולת העוף</he> you must not buy birds for burnt offerings out of the funds designated for public free-will offerings.
<cite ref="Tosefta Menahot 10:8">Tosef. Men. X, 8</cite> (expl. <he>קַיִץ המזבח</he>) <he>לוקחין … ומקיצין וכ׳</he> they buy therewith burnt offerings to supply the altar &c.
